description: Read steel and safeguard quota rows extracted from official act tables. Use this for allocated volumes and out-of-quota duty; trade_list_measures lists regulatory actions, and TARIC provides remaining balances. Filters narrow together; CN matches both prefix directions using the first eight digits. Returns quotas with order_number, product, CN codes, country, tonnes per period, duty and act URL, plus count/has_more/next_cursor/feed. history=false keeps the newest act per order; true includes replaced rows. Reuse next_cursor with unchanged filters to page (offset pagination, not a durable change checkpoint). Check feed freshness; this is not live quota availability. Free keyless allowance: 100 successful answers/day when metered, unlimited otherwise. API keys retain their credit policy. No MCP payment flow; exhaustion returns the HTTP alternative.

celex.description: Exact regulation CELEX: 3 + four-digit year + R + four digits, e.g. 32026R1457; omit for all acts

cn.description: CN/TARIC code, 4 to 10 digits after removing spaces and dots, e.g. 7208 or 72085120

country.description: Country name substring, 3 to 60 Unicode letters or spaces/punctuation (period, apostrophe, parentheses, hyphen), e.g. India; omit for all countries

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from this tool's prior answer; q followed by 1 to 6 digits, e.g. q0. Keep filters unchanged; omit on first call.

history.description: Also rows replaced by later acts (default false)

name: trade_list_quotas
title: List EU tariff quota tables
